<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><xsd:schema xmlns:xsd="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema" xmlns="http://www.ibm.com/xmlns/prod/bpm/bpmn/ext/externalservice/swagger/xsd/fc2d8dbf-3404-457c-a884-1b9145709e8e.xsd" xmlns:ibmbpm="http://lombardi.ibm.com/schema/" targetNamespace="http://www.ibm.com/xmlns/prod/bpm/bpmn/ext/externalservice/swagger/xsd/fc2d8dbf-3404-457c-a884-1b9145709e8e.xsd">
  <xsd:element name="create_mailRequest" type="create_mailRequest"/>
  <xsd:element name="create_mailResponse" type="create_mailResponse"/>
  <xsd:complexType name="create_mailRequest">
    <xsd:sequence>
      <xsd:element minOccurs="0" name="CC" type="xsd:string">
        <xsd:annotation optional="true" title="Cc">
          <xsd:documentation>The email addresses of the carbon-copy (Cc) recipients whom you intend to apprise of the email. Use comma between each email address.</xsd:documentation>
        </xsd:annotation>
      </xsd:element>
      <xsd:element minOccurs="0" name="To" type="xsd:string">
        <xsd:annotation optional="true" title="To">
          <xsd:documentation>The email addresses of one or more recipients. Use comma between each email address.</xsd:documentation>
        </xsd:annotation>
      </xsd:element>
      <xsd:element minOccurs="0" name="BCC" type="xsd:string">
        <xsd:annotation optional="true" title="Bcc">
          <xsd:documentation>The email addresses of the blind carbon copy (Bcc) recipients whom you intend to apprise of the email privately. Use comma between each email address.</xsd:documentation>
        </xsd:annotation>
      </xsd:element>
      <xsd:element minOccurs="0" name="Subject" type="xsd:string">
        <xsd:annotation optional="true" title="Subject">
          <xsd:documentation>A phrase that summarizes the email content</xsd:documentation>
        </xsd:annotation>
      </xsd:element>
      <xsd:element maxOccurs="unbounded" minOccurs="0" name="Attachments" type="AttachmentsType" xpathBeforeFlattening="/xsd:schema/xsd:complexType[@name='create_mailRequest']/xsd:sequence/xsd:element[@name='Attachments']">
        <xsd:annotation optional="true" title="Attachments">
          <xsd:documentation>One or more files to attach to the email</xsd:documentation>
        </xsd:annotation>
      </xsd:element>
      <xsd:element minOccurs="0" name="richTextBody" type="richTextBodyType" xpathBeforeFlattening="/xsd:schema/xsd:complexType[@name='create_mailRequest']/xsd:sequence/xsd:element[@name='richTextBody']">
        <xsd:annotation optional="true" title="Body">
          <xsd:documentation>The body content of the email</xsd:documentation>
        </xsd:annotation>
      </xsd:element>
    </xsd:sequence>
  </xsd:complexType>
  <xsd:complexType name="create_mailResponse">
    <xsd:sequence>
      <xsd:element minOccurs="0" name="id" type="xsd:string">
        <xsd:annotation optional="true" title="Message ID">
          <xsd:documentation>The unique identifier of an email message</xsd:documentation>
        </xsd:annotation>
      </xsd:element>
    </xsd:sequence>
  </xsd:complexType>
  <xsd:complexType name="AttachmentsType">
    <xsd:sequence>
      <xsd:element minOccurs="0" name="content" type="xsd:string">
        <xsd:annotation optional="true" title="Content">
          <xsd:appinfo>
            <contentRef xmlns="http://www.ibm.com/xmlns/prod/bpm/annotation/twclass"/>
          </xsd:appinfo>
          <xsd:documentation>The content of the file attachment. If the content type is binary, specify the content in Base64-encoded format.</xsd:documentation>
        </xsd:annotation>
      </xsd:element>
      <xsd:element minOccurs="0" name="fileName" type="xsd:string">
        <xsd:annotation optional="true" title="File name">
          <xsd:documentation>The file name, including the extension, of the attachment, for example test.pdf, test.docx, or test.txt</xsd:documentation>
        </xsd:annotation>
      </xsd:element>
    </xsd:sequence>
  </xsd:complexType>
  <xsd:complexType name="richTextBodyType">
    <xsd:sequence>
      <xsd:element minOccurs="0" name="content" type="xsd:string">
        <xsd:annotation optional="true" title="Content">
          <xsd:documentation>The body content of the email</xsd:documentation>
        </xsd:annotation>
      </xsd:element>
      <xsd:element default="text/plain" minOccurs="0" name="contentType" type="contentTypeType" xpathBeforeFlattening="/xsd:schema/xsd:complexType[@name='create_mailRequest']/xsd:sequence/xsd:element[@name='richTextBody']/xsd:complexType/xsd:sequence/xsd:element[@name='contentType']">
        <xsd:annotation optional="true" title="Content type">
          <xsd:documentation>The content type of the email, such as text or HTML.</xsd:documentation>
        </xsd:annotation>
      </xsd:element>
    </xsd:sequence>
  </xsd:complexType>
  <xsd:simpleType name="contentTypeType">
    <xsd:restriction base="xsd:string">
      <xsd:enumeration value="text/plain"/>
      <xsd:enumeration value="text/html"/>
    </xsd:restriction>
  </xsd:simpleType>
</xsd:schema>
